Bug_Title: Members ignored during record serialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The bug in the code is the presence of a private static final ObjectStreamField[] serialPersistentFields and a private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream out) throws IOException method in a record class that implements Serializable. As per Java documentation, during the serialization and deserialization of records, these methods are ignored, causing unintended behavior. The buggy line numbers are 5 and 7.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the showBug() method is called in the test case. This method attempts to serialize a Record object, which contains members that are ignored during record serialization. This results in unintended behavior.
